title: Who Looks
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 117
medium: Interactive page (index.html): twelve still works about the 568 meteorites Wikidata weighs, each by a fresh maker from one brief, shown as filmstrips of every look the maker took at its own picture (with what it did after each look) ending in the work it handed in; blind coders' notes per row; every frame opens at full size. A figure (figure.svg); a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving, put on a counter. Eight makers given a viewer all used it, changed their work after every look but the last, and handed in exactly what the last look showed. The look worked as a stop: it repaired, twice it reshaped, and the works it passed were no cleaner to a blind coder than those of four makers who never had a viewer.
project_step: Thirteenth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with iterating and judging). Takes from experiment 12 its by-product F-203 (11 of 18 makers never saw their work; the shown makers looked) and its open thread 3 (give every maker a sanctioned place to render, record who looks and what changes), its makers, its blind coders and its declared reading of reports; uses a material with no cycle, which bears on experiment 12's thread 1 (fold or family). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing, T1 (map as performance, tracing as competence, ATP 12-13; failure criterion: no case in which the map changed a working decision).
material: Wikidata, items that are meteorites (Q60186 and subclasses) and state a mass (P2067), with coordinates and dates where given; one SPARQL query 2026-10-08, 657 rows, 568 items after one item per meteorite (largest mass) and one ambiguous unit left out; CC0; raw response in sources/; domain: meteoritics
seed: prepare.py seed 117 (assignment of makers to arms); mask.py seeds 1170 (pairs) and 1171 (finals); makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
